scope: Equilibrium thermodynamics on a round spatial three-sphere
status: Equilibrium identities checked; weak-coupling phase-boundary slope sourced; microscopic thermal solver and cosmological X history open

inputs.theory: Record gauge group, matter content, N and limit, renormalization scheme, physical scales
inputs.ensemble: Canonical at beta=1/T; other couplings and charges held fixed in thermodynamic derivatives
inputs.geometry: S^1_beta x S^3_R, round static spatial metric, V=2*pi^2*R^3, natural units
inputs.free_energy: Total branch free energies F_i(T,R), with a common vacuum subtraction and absolute convention for any gravitational use
microscopic_inputs_open: branch-resolved thermal Z or saddle action including common terms
consistent physical radius and state of sector X
inputs.adiabat: Specify occupied homogeneous branch, S0 and initial R; require an invertible entropy-temperature relation on the interval

derived.coexistence: F_2(Tc,R)=F_1(Tc,R); Delta=branch2-branch1 evaluated at Tc; Delta_E=Tc*Delta_S != 0
derived.relative_slope: d ln(T/Tc)/d ln R at fixed S=(partial_T D)_R/C_R-Delta_D/Delta_E
derived.crossing_test: For continuous states and C_R>0, the sign of T(S0,R)-Tc(R) equals the sign of S0-S_i(Tc(R),R) on the same branch. Check for a sign change across contact.
thermal_history_open: transfer to plasma and cosmological expansion

cases.N4_SYM: Fixed exactly marginal coupling and F_i=phi_i(T*R)/R imply D_i=0, x_c=Tc*R constant and zero relative slope along a regular adiabat
cases.pure_YM: Planar non-Abelian sector on a small S^3: x_c=x_0*(1+lambda_A(1/R)/(12*pi^2)+O(lambda_A^2)); x_c rises locally with R at weak coupling. The matter adiabat requires independent branch entropy.
cases.cancellation_control: At R=1 and w=Tc^4=(1+sqrt(73))/9, Delta_D>0, relative slope=0, relative curvature=(627*sqrt(73)-6009)/1024 for the specified radial continuation
cases.stationary_boundary_control: Delta_D=0, Delta_E=4 and positive relative slope 2/11 at R=T=1 for the common thermal term example

SYMBOLICALLY_CHECKED: At a regular equal-slope contact y_zz=-S_c,zz/C_R. A stationary inflection can cross.
Specified control: unique global minimum S*=2.32825685449037 at R=1. For 0<S0<S* there is no contact; at S* one tangency; for S*<S0<4 two crossings; for S0>=4 one finite-radius crossing.
SOURCE_DERIVED: hep-th/0608156 (1.2), (5.8-5.9) and text after (5.1); hep-th/0412029 (4.1): lambda_std=2*lambda_A. Leading v_c=11*lambda_std^2/(576*pi^4)=1/(11*L^2), L=ln(1/(R*Lambda)). Higher-order error at a given radius is not bounded by the leading term.
hep-th/0310285 (5.15),(5.58) and hep-th/0608156 (2.16): free pure gauge, N to infinity before the one-sided temperature limits: R*Delta_E/N^2=3/4 and Delta_S/N^2=3*ln(2+sqrt(3))/4.
OPEN: Occupied branch entropy on the interacting coexistence line with initial entropy and radius for X
Conversion dynamics and a consistent BBN or GW source history

partition_convention: physical content of the trace and any common g(R) factor
include free U(1) for U(N) or remove it for pure SU(N)
thermal_sectors.thermal_contact: Specify a common equilibrium temperature with maintained thermal contact, or evolve decoupled components at their own temperatures. Identify any transfer to visible plasma separately.

photon_free_reference.interpretation: One free transverse vector on round S^3; the entropy ratio 0.57226 uses 9 times the planar entropy jump.

thermal_sectors.confined_nonzero_coupling: Entropy coefficients from the small-x, first-order-in-lambda_A, k=4,5,6 terms of hep-th/0608156 Eq. (4.36); valid away from Hagedorn. They do not fix S_i,c.
thermal_sectors.open: Non-Abelian branch entropy on the interacting coexistence line, physical coupling of sector X to the background, and conversion kinetics.
